_README: Mission environments. Communication delay decides how much the crew must act on its own. Only sourced values are given.

station.label: Space station (low Earth orbit)
station.comm_delay: Near real-time contact with Mission Control.

mars_transit.label: Mars transit vehicle
mars_transit.comm_delay: 4 to 24 minutes one way: a question to Earth gets its answer 8 to 48 minutes later.
mars_transit.source: NASA, 'Space Communications: 7 Things You Need to Know'. https://www.nasa.gov/missions/tech-demonstration/space-communications-7-things-you-need-to-know

lunar_base.label: Lunar surface base
lunar_base.comm_delay: Short delay; conversation with Mission Control is practical.
